title: SpectraNS-3D: a reproducible numerical methodology for unforced 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes vortex-tube studies
description:
Validation-first Fourier pseudo-spectral solver and campaign evidence for unforced, positive-viscosity vortex tubes on the 2π-periodic cube.

The release contains the audited solver, independent numerical tests, operational controllers, and a completed N512/N640/N768 study through t = 1.10. N640/N768 integral quantities agree within 0.1% (enstrophy 0.0128%, scaled net production 0.0804%), while stable local Fourier vorticity estimates differ by 1.53% at t = 1.00 and 1.11% at t = 1.10. The study shows that close two-grid agreement can give misleading confidence for local vorticity peaks.

This is a finite-interval numerical study. It does not establish regularity, blowup or an enstrophy turnover, and it is not a reproduction or assessment of any analytical Navier–Stokes result.
